program_description: Provides eligible owners of competing automotive brands with an incentive toward the purchase or lease of a qualifying Chevrolet vehicle.

program_certificates.certificate_description: Illustrative $1,000 purchase or lease incentive for eligible owners of competing vehicle brands.

program_guidelines.description: Customer must provide acceptable proof of ownership or lease of an eligible competing brand.
The purchased or leased Chevrolet vehicle must qualify under the program.
Only one conquest certificate may be redeemed per qualifying vehicle transaction.
The program must be active and the certificate valid when the incentive is applied.
